commitments.statement: Pixel Art Workbench is an external reusable tool in its own repository, not an Editor's Desk subsystem.
Automated output is always identified as a reference underpainting that requires human pixel authorship.
Input images remain local; there is no upload, account, analytics, or remote inference path.
Publish Pixel Art Workbench publicly on GitHub under the MIT License.

source.note: The repository owner selected public visibility and MIT licensing.
